title: Real-data nuisance-variable coverage and eligible trial-count inventory (pre-proxy-design gate)
purpose: Factual, read-only inventory of what nuisance variables are actually observable in the real omission corpus, and what real per-cell trial counts look like, ahead of designing observable proxies for the oracle-validated distributed-lag conditional-predictive-coupling estimator. No estimator run on real data; no directionality claim made.

task2_eligible_trial_count_inventory.methodology: For every (subject, session) x (omission condition, omission slot) cell among the 9 real omission-carrying condition names (AXAB/AAXB/AAAX, BXBA/BBXA/BBBX, RXRR/RRXR/RRRX at slots 2/3/4 respectively), counted CORRECT trials via OmissionSession.get_epochs(phase=slot, condition=cond, correct_only=True). Also censused unit counts per session by quality tier via OmissionSession.get_units().
task2_eligible_trial_count_inventory.cell_definition: one (subject, session, condition, omission_slot) combination -- this is the per-cell trial count the distributed-lag estimator would condition on for a given unit at that session/condition/slot; trial count does not vary by unit within a cell (unit tier instead multiplies how many such cells exist per session).

threshold_callouts.interpretation: NOT ONE per-session per-condition per-slot cell reaches the n=300 regime the synthetic distributed-lag work has been calibrated at. Nearly all (196/198) fall below the n=100-200 range flagged in this project's own history as where earlier matched-permutation controls degraded sharply.

pooled_across_sessions_within_subject.methodology: Same cells summed across all sessions of a given subject (subject, condition, slot) -- reported as an upper bound only; pooling sessions changes the sampling/independence unit (cross-session pooling is not the same replication structure as within-session trials) and is NOT recommended without an explicit session-random-effect or session-blocked design (per omission-statistics doctrine on pseudo-replication).
pooled_across_sessions_within_subject.caveat: Even under this optimistic, statistically non-trivial pooling, more than half of subject-level cells still fall short of n=300.

task2_eligible_trial_count_inventory.note_on_lowest_session: sub-V198o_ses-230629_rec has an unusually small intervals table (4,163 rows vs 10,000-18,000+ for every other session, per the NWB field probe) -- this single session accounts for all 9 of the lowest cells and is likely a short/incomplete recording, not representative of typical session length. Excluding it does not change the headline finding (0/198 cells reach n=300 regardless).

unit_census_by_session.finding: In every session probed, is_stable, stable_plus, and (quality==1.0) are IDENTICAL boolean columns (0 rows differ) -- confirmed directly on sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec (226 True / 131 False in all three). This collapses the omission-data skill's documented 4-tier scheme (stable_plus / stable / mua / unstable) to an effective BINARY split in this corpus: 'stable_plus' vs 'not-stable'. Per this project's tripwire 8 ('check whether a column is constant/varies before interpreting it'), this is reported as a finding, not assumed.
unit_census_by_session.per_session: see omission/artifacts/.lab/ receipt companion data (trial_count_audit.py output) for the full 22-row per-session table; range of n_stable_plus per session: 95 (sub-V182o_ses-260710) to 354 (sub-V198o_ses-230629_rec, ironically the session with the fewest omission trials).

summary: Design/timing/identity variables (condition, position, sequence history, preceding identity, cycle, trial index, subject/session id) are fully available, 0% missing, genuinely pre-event, and already wired into existing jnwb/omission accessors -- usable today with no new engineering. Neural pre-state variables (pre-event LFP/MUAe baseline, pre-event band power, pre-event SPK/MUAe firing, preceding-stimulus LFP/firing response) are all physically present and pre-event, but require composing existing generic accessors (analog.load_lfp_epochs/load_muae_epochs + onset_fitting.causal_bandpass) with a new pre-event window rather than a ready-made single call; per-trial missingness from edge-of-recording drops was not quantified this pass. No per-trial event-response-latency variable is materialized anywhere in the codebase today (only session/unit-level aggregates exist), so it is not usable as-is; building one would be a jnwb API change, out of scope for an audit. Behaviorally, pupil diameter and eye (gaze) position are present at 1000 Hz for ALL 22 sessions and all 3 subjects with 0% session-level gaps -- a real, uniform, currently-untapped common-cause-proxy resource -- but matched_empty.py explicitly disables behavioral columns today ('behavior_available is always False'), and no trial-aligned accessor exists yet (would need a new analog-style loader, following the existing LFP/MUAe pattern). Saccade/microsaccade and accelerometry/movement are genuinely absent from the corpus (no raw field in any of the 22 files); a measured fixation-state signal is also absent (only task-configured fixation-window parameters exist). On sample size: the real operating trial-count regime is substantially worse than the n=300 regime the synthetic calibration work has validated. Across all 198 (subject x session x condition x omission-slot) cells, the median is 39 trials, the maximum is 104, and not a single cell reaches 300; 196/198 (99%) fall below 100, squarely inside the n=100-200 range this project's own prior work found earlier matched-permutation controls to degrade in. Pooling every session within a subject (a non-trivial statistical step that changes the independence structure and is not recommended without an explicit session-blocked design) still leaves 15/27 (56%) of subject-level cells below n=300, with a floor of 109. Any real-data application of the estimator must either substantially relax its n=300 calibration target, aggressively pool across a statistically justified unit (e.g. condition family and/or session with an explicit random-effects design), or accept materially lower power/precision than the synthetic validation demonstrated.
